name: textarea
title: Textarea
blurb: Lightweight textarea with focus ring and validation styling.
description: A minimal textarea component extending standard HTML textarea attributes with theme-aware Tailwind styling, focus indicators, and aria-invalid error states.
use_when: Building accessible forms with consistent, minimal textarea styling.
avoid_when: When special textarea variants with animations or growth features are needed.
a11y: Fully semantic HTML; respects aria-invalid for error states and includes proper focus-visible styling.
